understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to place every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'. A level is only won when all goals are occupied simultaneously, and completing all levels wins the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces are selected and moved by clicking positions on the grid. Movement is constrained by walls and obstacles; clicks that would lead to blocked or invalid movement do nothing but still consume a step. Pieces can interact with obstacles and may push movable objects when the path allows it, while walls cannot be crossed. Efficient planning is necessary because each level has a finite number of actions.
